主要内容: Insperity, Inc. announced that its President, Mr. Rawson, established new structured, prearranged trading plans to sell a portion of his beneficially owned shares of Insperity common stock over a six-month period in accordance with Rule 10b5-1 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The plans allow Mr. Rawson to sell a maximum of 67,557 shares, representing approximately 10% of his current common stock holdings. The plans were initiated during the company's open window for insider transactions. Rule 10b5-1 permits insiders to implement written plans for selling stock at times when they are not in possession of material nonpublic information, enabling regular and non-discretionary sales regardless of subsequent material nonpublic information.
